0022600093.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Kings visit the Clippers, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Sacramento a 35% chance to win. The Kings are without Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), with Kobe Sanders (hip) and Kris Dunn (rest) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. Sacramento lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 138-109 defeat at home on April 5, 2026.
